# amesh Provider

Manage AMESH configuration through its public API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    amesh = {
      source  = "amesh/amesh"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "amesh" {
  endpoint = "http://localhost:8000"
  tenant   = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) AMESH API base URL. Defaults to AMESH_ENDPOINT or http://localhost:8000.
- `tenant` (String) Tenant header used for API calls. Defaults to AMESH_TENANT or default.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) AMESH bearer token. Prefer the AMESH_TOKEN environment variable.
